name: codex-council
description: Token-aware Codex Council, Forge and Mind workflows with a local experimental Decision Runtime for replayable decision evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Run token-aware multi-agent deliberation inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex Council adapts council-style review to Codex-only workflows: six independent role lenses, anonymous rubric review, blockers and dissent, Forge proposal generation, Mind end-to-end judgment, adaptive routing, local intelligence artifacts, health and stats tooling, and an experimental shadow-only Decision Runtime with deterministic cells, frontier comparison, transactional generations, typed patches, recovery and fail-closed impact planning.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Mind to forge this idea and judge it end to end.
Use Codex Council to review this change for blockers and verification.
Project this completed session into the experimental Decision Runtime.
